title: Transfers from Cordoba to Granada
text: We got a private transfer from Cordoba to Granada for our family of 6 with luggage. Everything was fantastic. Communication was great and clear. Pick up and drop off we’re on time. Payment was easy and clear. Would definitely recommend.
author: Safari559876

title: Well worth the Trip!!
text: We were struggling to find a good option for our party of four to get from Granada to Rhonda without it taking most of the day on a train/bus and rentals were an insane price.  So glad we came across Daytrip, a private transfer service.   Francisco our driver was wonderful, we had booked to have a stop along the way to do some sight seeing and he had some excellent recommendations. Throughly enjoyed our trip and would highly recommend.
author: Meander35746399133
